import os
import psycopg
import json

dsn = os.environ.get("APP_DB_URL", "").strip()
assert dsn, "APP_DB_URL missing"

conn = psycopg.connect(dsn)
conn.autocommit = True
cur = conn.cursor()

cur.execute("SELECT current_database()")
db_name = cur.fetchone()[0]
cur.execute("SELECT table_schema FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_name = 'actimize_screening_type_mappings' ORDER BY table_schema LIMIT 1")
row = cur.fetchone()
schema_name = row[0] if row and row[0] else "public"

cur.execute("SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = 'screening_ro_user'")
if cur.fetchone() is None:
    raise RuntimeError("Role screening_ro_user does not exist")

cur.execute(
    """
    DO $$
    BEGIN
      IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = 'db_owbner') THEN
        CREATE ROLE db_owbner NOLOGIN;
      END IF;
    END
    $$;
    """
)

cur.execute(f"GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON DATABASE {db_name} TO db_owbner")
cur.execute(f"GRANT USAGE, CREATE ON SCHEMA {schema_name} TO db_owbner")
cur.execute(f"GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA {schema_name} TO db_owbner")
cur.execute(f"GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON ALL SEQUENCES IN SCHEMA {schema_name} TO db_owbner")
cur.execute(f"GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON ALL ROUTINES IN SCHEMA {schema_name} TO db_owbner")
cur.execute(f"ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES IN SCHEMA {schema_name} GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON TABLES TO db_owbner")
cur.execute(f"ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES IN SCHEMA {schema_name} GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON SEQUENCES TO db_owbner")
cur.execute(f"ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES IN SCHEMA {schema_name} GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON ROUTINES TO db_owbner")
cur.execute("GRANT db_owbner TO screening_ro_user")

cur.execute(
    """
    SELECT r.rolname AS member, m.rolname AS granted_role
    FROM pg_auth_members am
    JOIN pg_roles r ON r.oid = am.member
    JOIN pg_roles m ON m.oid = am.roleid
    WHERE r.rolname = 'screening_ro_user'
      AND m.rolname = 'db_owbner'
    """
)
memberships = [{"member": r[0], "granted_role": r[1]} for r in cur.fetchall()]

print("GRANT_DB_OWBNER_OK", json.dumps({"database": db_name, "schema": schema_name, "memberships": memberships}))

cur.close()
conn.close()
